name: LFC RO Simulator
description: Simulation model base for Live Fish Carrier water production: identifies areas suitable for RO water production, alerts when producing near fish farms or on shallows, and gives predictive maintenance instructions (CIP, extended freshwater flush).
versionDescription: 3D-nakyma: mitatut suureet nimetty uudelleen (esim. CT-301 = Produced water conductivity) ja naytetaan slider-mittareina, joissa vihrea = normal, keltainen = varoitus, punainen = hairio (rajat ja asteikko PLC Tag Map -datasetissa). CT-301: 0-500 vihrea, 500-700 keltainen, 700-1000 punainen uS/cm; simuloitu johtavuus skaalattu realistiselle SWRO-permeaatin alueelle.
